$comment: Documents a DELIBERATE divergence (#1376): test-e2e-deploy.yml's NEXTJS_REF (the Next.js ref every compat cell tests) currently differs from packages/kn-next/templates/app/package.json.hbs's next pin (the Next.js version the scaffold actually ships). tests/nextjs-credential-lockstep.test.ts fails if either real value drifts from what THIS file documents, so a future bump to either side must update this manifest in the same PR — a reviewed decision, never silent drift.
divergenceReason: Next 16.3.0 introduced a confirmed upstream regression (Turbopack + adapterPath + output:'standalone' -> ENOENT next-server.js.nft.json, vercel/next.js; see issue #1372), fixed upstream in 16.3.5 (the scaffold's pin as of this bump). The regression window is bisected to 16.3.0-canary.20 through 16.3.4; 16.2.x was never affected. The credentialed lane stays at v16.2.0 rather than moving to 16.3.5 in the SAME change: re-credentialing on the fixed version is a separate, deliberate decision (tracked in #1376) so the compat suite's own 14-consecutive-nightly-run bar is met on purpose, not as a side effect of a pin bump.
